title: Get authorized TTO Creator Marketplace accounts
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain a list of TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace accounts that authorized the developer app. >**Note**
> To obtain information of the user who authorized the developer app, use the [/user/info/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739665513181185) endpoint. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/oauth2/tcm/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | app_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer application.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/oauth2/tcm/?app_id={{app_id}}&secret={{secret}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| tto_tcm_account_ids | string[]| The ID list of TikTok One Creator Marketplace accounts that authorized the developer app (`app_id`).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "tto_tcm_account_ids": [ "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}" ] } } (/code) ```
